svg.title: Red Green
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and standardized vivid colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. Red upper-left panel joined to green lower-right panel, overall hanging diagonal. Artwork outline hand traced; surrounding gray is wall, not paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=168; record guggenheim1996-cat-52; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
